description: Fork of exp003: out_proj tph front-loaded [4096, 4096, 2048, 2048, 2048, 2048] (4096 only on layers 0,1) and out_input_nap 10->8 (table_dim 1024->256, 4× smaller per-table). Net out_proj capacity drops 402.7M -> 134.2M bits but doubles per-token bandwidth on early layers (4096 tph means 2× more lookup parallelism per token). Tests whether more diverse anchor patterns (more tables × smaller tables) helps when per-layer capacity is similar.
